image_urls.description: Smart city sanitation dashboard & map analytics

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a fully responsive React app supporting both Mobile App Simulation view and Municipal Operations Dashboard view with role switching (Citizen, Municipal Staff, Recycling Partner).

Implement AI-powered waste response decision support system with features: camera/photo capture, live GPS coordinates, category selection (overflowing bin, garbage dump, plastic, construction debris, organic, e-waste, hazardous, drain blockage), volume estimation, duplicate detection, severity scoring (1-10), and recommended interventions.
Include real-time notification toasts using sonner, interactive maps/hotspots, assignee vehicle routing, verification cleanup photo upload, and citizen reward points leaderboards.
Ensure all interactive and key informational elements include data-testid attributes for robust automated testing.
Never use full transparency on headers or overlays; ensure high contrast WCAG compliance.
universal_guidelines: Avoid generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters.
Always use modern button styles with hover/press micro-animations.
Every interactive element must include data-testid attributes.
